problem:
$$
{{[\begin{aligned}5 & -2 & 0 \\ -10 & 7 & 9 \\ 40 & -13 & 8\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -2 & 1 & 0 \\ 8 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}5 & -2 & 0 \\ \boxed{} & \boxed{} & \boxed{} \\ 0 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U}.
$$

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. From left to right, what are the missing elements from the second row of the matrix $U?$

feedback.problem:
$$
{{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 2 & -6 \\ 7 & 18 & -19\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -3 & 1 & 0 \\ 7 & 9 & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & \boxed{}\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U}.
$$

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. What is the value of ${u}_{33}$ in the matrix $U?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The matrix $U$ in the LU decomposition is obtained from the original matrix $A$ by row-reducing using Gaussian elementation. In particular, to make zeros below the main diagonal, we proceed as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 2 & -6 \\ 7 & 18 & -19\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & -3 \\ 7 & 18 & -19\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-7){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 18 & -26\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-9){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, ${u}_{33}=1.$
